g.text: a. Targets: 27 (six main regions and Alaska in mode x; ten sub-regions in modes i and x). P4 = Lena, Canada, Russia W and Russia E. AL, CA and LE sub-

text.style: font: 6.5px 'Arial', 'Liberation Sans', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif

g.text: regions belong to Alaska, Canada and Lena and are not independent.

text.style: font: 6.5px 'Arial', 'Liberation Sans', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif

g.text: b. Rows, label rows of the label table (n counts rows); 1 km loc., locations by the cell index ky = floor(lat/0.009), kx = floor(lon cos φ/0.009);

text.style: font: 6.5px 'Arial', 'Liberation Sans', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif

g.text: Blocks, 0.5° blocks; Splits, valid splits of five.

text.style: font: 6.5px 'Arial', 'Liberation Sans', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif

g.text: c. A cells and scored cells are ranges over valid splits (A = labelled half, scored = evaluation cells of the B half); Greenland has no valid split and

text.style: font: 6.5px 'Arial', 'Liberation Sans', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif

g.text: is scored on invalid splits for point estimates only.

text.tspan: d. E0 in cm (°C d), source pool of mode x (sub-regions: x / i).

text.style: font: 6.5px 'Arial', 'Liberation Sans', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif

g.text: e. LGD rows are the licence-verified edition (main verdicts). Cells with unverified licence are not listed (Canada 38, North Atlantic 19, Russia W 1).

text.style: font: 6.5px 'Arial', 'Liberation Sans', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif

g.text: North Atlantic (41 cells in the full edition, 22 licence-verified) is ineligible in the licence-verified edition and appears in the SI only.

text.style: font: 6.5px 'Arial', 'Liberation Sans', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif
